description:
File: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:373-430

The tests web_pki_missing_server_auth_eku_rejected (line 373) and web_pki_wrong_eku_rejected (line 414) perform identical verification: both
(1) load webpki-self-signed-365d.der
(2) override required_leaf_eku to emailProtection
(3) assert MissingEku

web_pki_missing_server_auth_eku_rejected also includes a pass case (cert with serverAuth passes), making it more comprehensive. web_pki_wrong_eku_rejected duplicates only the failure case.

This is redundant test code. Having two identical failure cases provides no additional coverage and adds noise.

Fix: Remove web_pki_wrong_eku_rejected (it is fully subsumed by web_pki_missing_server_auth_eku_rejected's second half).
notes: Opinion-labeled: the duplicate test provides belt-and-suspenders coverage. Deferred.
title: pkix-profiles tests: web_pki_missing_server_auth_eku_rejected and web_pki_wrong_eku_rejected are duplicate tests
